senses.def: An expression of delight or joy.
ex: Oh, boy! I can't wait to tell my friends about this!

senses.def: An expression of dismay, resignation, frustration, or annoyance (sarcastic).
ex: Oh, boy. This is going to be a lot of work.
Oh, boy. Now what do I do?

senses.def: used as an expression of frustration, disgust, disbelief, or incredulity
